properties.value: Welcome to the Rebel Village! No shenanigans or you'll be sent to the Sarlacc pit.
properties.name: Dialogue

properties.value:
What happened? All I remember is being chased by a wizard. He cornered me, zapped me with his wand, and then I blacked out. And what's this? Looks like I have some sort of medallion. I don't remember what it's for, but I'll trade it to you for that bag of magic.
?Wanna trade your magic bag for my medallion?
Thank you, here is the medallion. Hope it brings you luck.
Ok, let me know if you change your mind. I need to rest for a bit.
I need to rest for a bit.
properties.name: Response

properties.value: What's all this ruckus!?\Can't a dead king get any peace\and quiet around here?\My Medallion!\Where on earth did you find it?\Some guy stole it from me before\I died, so I had my wizard turn\him into a tree.
properties.name: Dialogue

properties.value:
?Can I have my medallion? I'll give\you the key to my treasure room.
Thank you for my medallion
Thank you, I can rest in peace now. Here is the key to my treasure! Farewell!
Ok, I understand. Let me know if you change your mind.
Bring me my medallion and I will give you the key to my treasure room.
properties.name: Response

properties.value: Here lies Fred.\He used to bake bread.\But now he's dead.
properties.name: Text

properties.value: \Here lies the great King of Hyrule
properties.name: Text

properties.value:
I'm looking for my contact lens, let me know if you find it.
I lost my lense looking for treasure. I heard a rumor there's some hidden in this desert.
properties.name: Dialogue

properties.value:
Have you seen the weird tree by the bridge? Rumor has it that it used to be a person.
I hear only magic can revive him. But I don't believe in such things.
properties.name: Dialogue

properties.value: Please check up on me once in a while.
properties.name: Text

properties.value: Before the king died, he hid his fortune behind that locked door. I hear he buried himself with the key. I wonder how much treasure is behind there?
properties.name: Dialogue

properties.value:
You found the key to the King's treasure! What are you going to spend the money on? I would live in the arcade if I had that kind of money. Don't spend it all in one place!
So how much money was in there?
properties.name: Response

properties.value:
To me, it's a good idea to always carry two sacks of something when you walk around. That way, if anybody says, "Hey, can you give me a hand?" you can say, "Sorry, got these sacks."
If you saw two guys named Hambone and Flippy, which one would you think liked dolphins the most? I'd say Flippy, wouldn't you? You'd be wrong, though. It's Hambone.
When this girl at the art museum asked me whom I liked better, Monet or Manet, I said, "I like mayonnaise." She just stared at me, so I said it again, louder. Then she left. I guess she went to try to find some mayonnaise for me.
I guess of all my uncles, I liked Uncle Cave Man the best. We called him Uncle Cave Man because he lived in a cave and because sometimes he'd eat one of us. Later on we found out he was a bear.
If you're ever shipwrecked on a tropical island and you don't know how to speak the natives' language, just say "Poppy-oomy". I bet it means something.
The wise man can pick up a grain of sand and envision a whole universe. But the stupid man will just lie down on some seaweed and roll around until he's completely draped in it. Then he'll stand up and go, "Hey, I'm Vine Man."
When I found the skull in the forest, the first thing I did was call the police. But then I started to wonder who this guy was, and why did he have antlers?
I can't stand cheap people. It makes me real mad when someone says something like, "Hey, when are you going to pay me that $100 you owe me?" or "Do you have that $50 you borrowed?". Man, quit being so cheap!
As the light changed from red to green to yellow and back to red again, I sat there thinking about life. Was it nothing more than a bunch of honking and yelling? Sometimes it seemed that way.
If you're a cowboy and you're dragging a guy behind your horse, I bet it would really make you mad if you looked back and the guy was reading a magazine.
properties.name: Dialogue

properties.value:
The name's Cowpoke Billy, fastest kid in town.
Well, I used to be fastest. I broke my leg trying to outrun someone.
properties.name: Dialogue

properties.value:
Check out my new sword, I bought it at the weapons shop.
I'm gonna use it to hack frogs by the lake.
properties.name: Dialogue

properties.value: Don't you know about the bird? Everybody knows that the bird is the word.
